messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: How to remove Shiny-server
parts:
Hi,
  Several months ago, I started to use Shiny-server-pro, and now it comes to its end of Beta test. So I want to remove it and install the open source version. anybody know to to remove the shiny-server. 
  I mean remove all files generated from (and after) installing Shiny-server?

Many thinks!

Huidong

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to remove Shiny-server
parts:
If you do the usual "sudo apt-get remove shiny-server" you should be
all set to install the open source version.

messages.subject: Re: How to remove Shiny-server
parts: For anyone else who comes here to uninstall pro: make sure you change your config file (/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf) to remove all the pro-only options, otherwise your server will not run
